description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Seeded from the RDP `decision` discipline rows in tests/reasoning-layer-eval/trigger-fixtures.json (choice among alternatives with real tradeoffs -> decision ledger; escalate to ADR only when cross-task/structural). Should-not covers tasks with no alternatives to weigh (mechanical / single-path). Extended 2026-07-20 with 5+5 weighted-matrix-mode cases: quantitative scoring asks trigger; RICE-shaped ranking, 2-option reversible, stakeholder-conflict, pure prioritization and explicit rice-prioritization asks do not.
